decisions.reason: Adding dimensions for red-marked walls does not change the separate furnished drawing or its required items.
The AutoCAD format and detailed-plan deliverable remain unchanged; the new annotation content is owned by the dimension-annotation Requirement.
The request concerns annotations on the current plan, not the content or purpose of the initial concept sketch.
Annotating red-marked wall dimensions does not alter the corridor-width issue or the specified 28 cm wall movement.
The dimensions are documentation for marked walls and do not change which red-marked walls are demolished, which walls are constructed, or the partition strategy.
The wall-dimension annotation request does not resolve or change the unit 1 ensuite arrangement or its existing value ambiguity.
The request does not change the common entrance location or the requirement for independent dwelling doors.
Adding marked-wall dimensions does not change the unit 1 common bathroom boundary, fixtures, or relationship to the ensuite.
The annotation request does not change the unit 3 bathroom door position or its kitchen-counter clearance constraint.
The request to display wall dimensions does not change the required bathroom or the shower location on the left wall.
Wall-dimension annotations do not change any bathroom drainage location, connection target, or unresolved drainage scope.
The request does not alter the requirement to preserve the existing exterior windows.
